subst. curatio; distinguish adjacent ፈዋሲ n.ag. medicus, sanator. Source noun is cure/healing, not a named healer.

subst. quies, requies. Adjacent rest adjective and place-of-rest noun are distinct entries, not interchangeable sourcewords.
